obligations.summary: Notified bodies shall verify the conformity of high-risk AI systems in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures set out in Article 43.

Notified bodies shall avoid unnecessary burdens for providers when performing their activities, taking due account of the provider's size, sector, structure, and the complexity of the high-risk AI system, particularly to minimise administrative burdens and compliance costs for micro- and small enterprises, while still respecting the required degree of rigour and level of protection.
exceptions: The obligation to minimise burdens does not override the requirement to maintain the degree of rigour and level of protection necessary for compliance with the Regulation.

obligations.summary: Notified bodies shall make available and submit upon request all relevant documentation, including providers' documentation, to the notifying authority to allow it to conduct assessment, designation, notification, and monitoring activities.
